parts:
On Monday, May 27, 2013 10:08:32 PM UTC-4, Daniel Lee wrote:
I'm not seeing any of that behavior. Can you get some more info? And you don't have any local modifications to any of the makefiles?

No modifications; just

git checkout remotes/origin/develop
make clean-all > /dev/null
make CC=clang++ -j8 bin/stanc 2&> /dev/null
make CC=clang++ -j8 test-distributions

I don't expect using test/agrad/distributions/normal_00000_generated to work: it's not a valid target. Does this one work?
test/agrad/distributions/univariate/continuous/normal_00000_generated

Also, test/model/command shouldn't work. It should be test/models/command

That is the breakage: It tries to compile targets that don't exist like

test/agrad/distributions/no_00000_generated
test/agrad/distributions/--help_00000_generated

which inevitably result in errors like

#include <mal_test>
         ^
src/test/agrad/distributions/--help_00000_generated_test.cpp:4:10: fatal error: 'elp' file not found
#include <elp>
         ^
or you can try something like make CC=clang++ test/agrad/distributions/normal_00000_generated and instead of saying that is not a valid make target, it says

src/test/agrad/distributions/normal_00000_generated_test.cpp:4:10: fatal error: 'mal' file not found
#include <mal>
Ben

Yikes! If you take a look at the test-distributions target, you'll see that things should be generated in alphabetical order. This is the block in the make/tests makefile that is relevant.


GENERATED_AGRAD_TESTS := $(shell find src/test/agrad/distributions -type f -name '*_test.hpp')
GENERATED_AGRAD_TESTS := $(GENERATED_AGRAD_TESTS:%_test.hpp=%_00000_generated_test.cpp)
##
# Agrad distributions test generator
##
test/agrad/distributions/generate_tests$(EXE) : src/test/agrad/distributions/generate_tests.cpp
    @mkdir -p $(dir $@)
    $(LINK.c) -O$(O_STANC) $(CFLAGS) $< $(OUTPUT_OPTION)
